resources.string: Allow automatic model downloads over mobile data
Detect the source language and translate visible home and search titles, detail titles and descriptions. Originals are retained. Content already in the target language is skipped.

Each new language may require a model download of about 30 MB. Downloads use Wi-Fi by default. Once models are installed, translation runs offline on device. Turning this off stops further translations; model downloads already started may still finish.
